title: Acquisition basis and dates are unknown
detail: No lot-level CNY acquisition dates, amounts or USD basis were supplied. Realized gain/loss and tax cells remain blank.

title: Transaction classification is unknown
detail: Personal, business and investment/income-producing use produce different U.S. character rules. The workbook does not assume the account is personal.

title: Tax year, filing status and taxable income are unknown
detail: No federal tax amount can be verified. IRS Topic 409 rate thresholds retrieved are labeled 2025; they are not applied to an unknown year.

title: No executable FX or transfer quote
detail: Treasury's 6.7050 CNY/USD rate is an official reporting reference, not a bank quote. Spread, sender, intermediary and receiver fees are blank.

title: Treasury PDF excludes online amendments
detail: The September 2026 PDF states amended rates are only online. This workbook uses the published PDF row and does not claim it is the latest amended rate.

title: Overbroad 0% U.S. conversion-tax claim
detail: portal/generate_portal.py line 188 displays '0% (PRC & US)' standalone conversion tax. U.S. tax can arise from currency disposition gain and underlying income; the individual amount is unverified. Requested change: replace categorical zero with a conditional statement and blank unverified amounts.

title: Personal FX exclusion stated too broadly
detail: portal/generate_portal.py line 119 says '0% income tax on principal; personal FX excluded under 26 USC §988(e) (≤$200 gain rule)'. The exclusion applies only to qualifying personal currency gain not exceeding $200; gain above $200 is not excluded by that sentence, and Pub. 525 says report as capital gain.

title: General 10-year FTC refund window is unsupported
detail: portal/generate_portal.py lines 164 and 220 and reports/CNY_TO_USD_RESEARCH_LEDGER.json CP-10/TC-06 describe a 10-year Form 1040-X refund window for PRC FTC. Form 1116 instructions provide a 1-year carryback and 10-year carryforward subject to limitations; the IRS FTC page's 10-year refund paragraph is French CSG/CRDS-specific.

title: FTC 'max(PRC tax, US tax)' simplification is unsafe
detail: reports/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY_85f37d08.md line 69 says combined tax equals max(PRC tax, US tax). FTC limitations, income categories, treaty-reduced rates, excluded income, state tax and other facts can prevent that result.

title: This is not a full route catalogue or provider price survey
detail: Other active sessions own the general method catalogue and cost matrices. This workbook supplies the U.S. currency-basis layer and correction requests; it does not certify every route or provider.
